metadata.image-alt: An illustrated TTRPG setting depicting a vibrant, detailed blue market building with bustling activity, stairs, lanterns, and annotated notes for game design.
metadata.image-description: This illustration presents an intricately detailed scene intended as a tabletop roleplaying game (TTRPG) opening scenario. The central feature is a vivid, blue-painted market building bustling with activity, featuring multiple floors and outdoor staircases connecting levels. Warm lantern lights illuminate various market stalls and interior spaces, creating an inviting and immersive atmosphere. Figures interact in small groups around crates and tables, suggesting active engagement and layered storytelling opportunities. Surrounding the image are handwritten annotations and design notes, hinting at hidden secrets, puzzles, and narrative possibilities integral to immersive gameplay. This richly illustrated environment enhances player engagement and narrative depth, perfect for detailed exploration in a TTRPG session.

coverImageAlt: Blank faceted navy medallion ringed by cyan elemental and tool tokens on a connecting thread.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: Tabletop role-playing skill profiling represented by a faceted blank medallion whose capabilities are revealed as a precise constellation of tactile tools and elemental tokens orbiting it, conveying a structured profile built from one named skill.
Scene/backdrop: A dark slate tabletop fading into warm paper, reminiscent of a handcrafted game-maker's studio without depicting a game interface.
Subject: One central unmarked navy-and-stone medallion, surrounded by distinct small cyan tokens shaped as a compass, climbing grip, flame, shield, and quill-like feather, joined only by thin physical thread and one orange bead.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe radial still life with a strong central medallion silhouette; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: imaginative, systematic, quietly adventurous
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: medallion and tokens must be blank and contain no marks or glyphs; no dice; completely original image; no input or reference images; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, product UI, vendor branding, Microsoft Fluent styling, paw imagery, paw logo, cats, or cat silhouettes
